name: Canada Post Receipt
description: This receipt is issued by Canada Post at the Strandherd R.O. location in Nepean, Ontario, and includes full address details along with a GST registration number. It contains key POS identifiers such as transaction date and time, terminal or operator code, transaction reference number, and payment routing details. The receipt outlines a service-based transaction with weight and destination information, followed by a financial summary section showing subtotal, tax, total amount, payment method, and calculated change. It also includes service disclaimers, sender declarations, and non-trackable service notices. Additional elements include a customer survey invitation, promotional messaging, barcode reference, bilingual tracking instructions, and official Canada Post website and contact information, reflecting a standard postal service transaction format.
